verdict.rationale: Baseten's public pricing-and-limits docs state that Model APIs bill by token and that cached input tokens are billed at a discounted rate. Account upgrades go through a self-serve form, so per-token pricing is documented without needing sales. However, no actual per-model price figures appear in the evidence. Missing for 10: actual published per-token prices per model, evidence that every hosted model is listed with input/output rates, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see public per-token prices for every hosted model without talking to sales

citations.quote: Model APIs bill by token and enforce request and token rate limits.
Cached input tokens are prompt tokens served from the KV cache at a discounted rate.
You can also use that form to move to Pro or Enterprise.
